The opaque wheels seem uniform, but I think I could enhance transparency in the spokes to reveal the background better. Currently, the wheels look a bit clunky. The current gradient on the water appears too strong, with dramatic sine ripples; I want to simplify that into thinner, subtler lines. I also aim for a shimmering effect on the water with short ripples, defined by a hash grid and sine noise to enhance the overall visual appeal. **Improving visual details** I’m adjusting the frequency constant and adding a tiny perturbation to create small horizontal lines—about 18 pixels apart—with limited distortion. The foreground lines at y=835 look nice, but I also want to make sure the corona rays have a broader starburst effect. The white body with a long neck is starting to resemble a swan more than a pelican, which is interesting! I also need to improve the bicycle size to make it relative to the pelican more adequate.
